cohort: 229 women with postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) refractory to first-line treatment at a secondary healthcare facility in Nigeria
finding: Condom-catheter uterine balloon tamponade (C-UBT) is an effective second-line treatment for postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) and is associated with low maternal morbidity rates.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with lower success rates of C-UBT compared to vaginal delivery.
